header.what: Answers with the verdict the cascade owes them, and pairs it must never place. What the grading gate in gate.test.ts measures on every run, so the tiers are measured rather than asserted.
header.how: Written by hand against the words this locale really teaches, read from corpus/fr. Small on purpose: a hand-built set cannot carry a representative rate, which is what the eval set in docs/ai-engineering.md exists for. What it can carry is that a named failure stays fixed.
header.answers: the verdict the free tiers owe. One that comes back undecided is a fall-through, and the budget is in docs/specs/v0.1.md
header.pairs: answers that must never come back correct. A card is answered with one of them, so placing it here would teach that card instead of this one
